text:
sarah: FYI PR #412 started failing in gha-eval-runner — runner 504 after ~18m on matrix shard quantize-3.
michael: same here, only on ubuntu-22. docker pull stalled then connection reset. :thinking_face:
sarah: logs snippet: ```
ERROR: upload-artifact failed: Post \"https://artifacts.redwood.ai/upload\": net/http: TLS handshake timeout
stack: /usr/local/bin/gha-runner:line 342
```
ci-bot: buildkite queued job: eval-nightly-shard-3 (https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/pipelines/evals/987)
jess: I pushed a small patch to .github/workflows/evals.yml to add retry with exponential backoff for upload-artifact. snippet: ```yaml
- name: upload artifacts
  uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
  with:
    name: eval-results
    path: results/
    if-no-files-found: error
  retry:
    attempts: 5
    delay: 10s
```
sarah: `actions/upload-artifact` doesn't support custom retry semantics that way. the runner_error is happening during network handshake, not the action itself. Need curl+signed-upload fallback.
ryan: idea: keep GHA for PR smoke (<=5m), and route anything longer to Buildkite via repo_dispatch. hybrid model. avoids long-running GHA jobs hitting ephemeral runners.
tara: dashboards are noisy — eval_ci_latency spikes when GHA starts more shards. alert: eval-runner-duration > 30m triggered 6x last night.
michael: hybrid sounds right. concrete plan:
- GHA job `eval-smoke` runs quick checks (unit-llm, 5 prompts)
- If smoke passes and PR requests full eval, trigger `repo_dispatch` to buildkite
- Buildkite runs full nightly and shards with durable agents + S3 artifact storage
- Add artifact upload fallback: try gha artifact, then curl to pre-signed S3, with exp backoff
sarah: security: for repo_dispatch we'll issue a limited PAT stored in org secrets with repo:dispatch scope and allowlist target repo ids. ops OK?
jess: I'll prototype GH Action that uploads partial results to S3 incrementally and writes a "partial_done.json" marker. If full run needed, BK will pick up partials and resume.
michael: also add a small metadata file so dashboard can merge partials: {"shard":3,"status":"partial","duration":1080} — dashboards can treat partial as "incomplete" not regression.
sarah: add gating rule: branch protection requires `eval-smoke` job to succeed for merge. full eval only for release branches via BK.
buildkite-bot: scheduled: eval-nightly (shards=24) at 03:00 UTC
ci-bot: note: occasional GH hosted runner OOM when quantize+batch > 6 on ubuntu-22. filing infra ticket.
ryan: one small thing — metrics: we need `eval_ci_quality/regressed` AND `eval_ci_run_mode` (smoke|partial|full) so alerts don't fire on partial runs. metrics should be emitted by eval harness on finish.
tara: will update dashboard panels to show run_mode and partial/merged artifact counts.
jess: PR #426 draft with fallback uploader and repo_dispatch trigger, will request reviews from @sarah @michael. test matrix limited to ubuntu-latest to catch handshake quicker.
sarah: great. tagging @michael for the org-secrets review and @ryan for BK pipeline mapping. i'll run a manual smoke on my branch now :rocket:
michael: :eyes: watching the run. if it flakes, we escalate to infra.
sarah: action items: 1) jess prototype uploader + backoff 2) ryan define repo_dispatch policy 3) michael add gating rule + metric emitter 4) tara update dashboard. we'll sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
